# Inventory export

Current state: novel-work planning, wayfinding active.

[Decision map](../../docs/planning/export/map.md).
[Design](../../docs/planning/export/design.md).

The agreed work includes CSV export, empty-inventory behavior, and behavior when the destination file already exists. CSV with name and quantity columns is agreed. Empty-inventory behavior and existing-file behavior are both open and unblocked. Current question: empty-inventory behavior.

steps.prompt: Empty inventory should create a CSV file. I have not decided whether that file contains column headings. I also have not decided what to do if the destination exists.

rubric.description: Records empty-inventory file creation as accepted in the existing feature record/map without upgrading that partial answer to header-only creation.
Represents column-heading content and destination-exists behavior as unresolved, while preserving accepted CSV format and name/quantity fields.
Asks an actionable next question about headings or the existing destination, with relevant choices and tradeoffs, rather than only reporting that planning remains open.
Keeps planning and its progress account consistent with the partial answer, avoids accepted-answer inflation, leaves production source unchanged, and makes no publication.
